provenance.method: Original PDF vector line vertices mapped to the original axes. Display playback interpolates these vertices; no simulation is rerun.

rollout.note: Figure asset read from 3_outline/figures/figure02_rollout_example.pdf; manuscript context is recorded separately.

provenance.supersaturation: Dimensionless supersaturation, plotted on the source axis from 0.001 to 0.1. The browser does not relabel these values as percentages.
provenance.freeze_domain: Source curves are retained outside the plot floor; the displayed log axis is 1e-10 to 1, matching the source ticks.
